description: This source file implements management functions for the Slap Owo Uoac Object, including attaching, detaching, removing, and cleaning object wrappers within a table structure. It provides functions to manage object lifecycles and references in a system that uses object wrappers and interface calls.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOwoUoacAttachObjWrapper(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hObjWrapper)
methods.description: Attaches a GOA object wrapper to the internal table by computing its hash and inserting it into the appropriate bucket, also sets the container handle.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOwoUoacDetachObjWrapper(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hObjWrapper)
methods.description: Detaches a specified GOA object wrapper from the hash table, removing it from its bucket, and clears its container handle.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOwoUoacRemoveObjWrapper(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hObjWrapper)
methods.description: Removes a GOA object wrapper by calling the detach method and then handles object access or deletion based on the object mode.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapOwoUoacCleanOwoTable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up all object wrappers in the table, releasing object access or deletion as specified by their mode, and clears container handles.
